# GikoMart

> GikoMart is a local marketplace that broadcasts listings to WhatsApp groups and channels so buyers see them fast.

## What GikoMart does
- Users post an item once.
- GikoMart shares the listing to local WhatsApp groups and channels.
- Buyers contact sellers directly on WhatsApp.

## Key pages
- Homepage: https://gikomart.onrender.com/
- Post a listing: https://gikomart.onrender.com/ (Sell view)
- Individual listing: https://gikomart.onrender.com/listing/<id>

## Notes
- Listings are local, not tied to any single institution.
- Prices are in Kenyan Shillings (KES).
- Storefronts are available for sellers who want an organized shop page.
